works.title: Entertainment as Revolutionary Vectors: Using Media to Build Political Consciousness
works.description: A structured framework exploring how fiction across multiple genres—romance novels, men's action/thriller fiction, and other entertainment media—can serve as vectors for political messaging about economic justice, class consciousness, and exposing conservative policy contradictions. Chapters focus on reaching distinct audiences through genre-specific narrative techniques and character archetypes.
works.quote: Chapter 33: Romance and Women's Fiction as Revolutionary Vectors... Chapter 34: Men's Fiction: Action, Thriller, and the Masculine Revolution
